title: Interfacial synergistic flame retardancy and smoke suppression in siloxane-modified epoxy resin/phosphoric acid-treated aramid fiber composites
authors: Yu Zhao; Lili Wu; Yundong Ji; Dongfeng Cao
source_version: Published September 2026 journal article; source reports first online 15 October 2025
source_document_description: Official 16-page PDF: two publisher cover pages followed by the 14-page journal article on PDF pages 3–16, printed pages 5542–5555
source_material_form_TGA_raw: P/EM finished aramid fabric/epoxy resin composites; twelve fabric layers; TG specimen length, width and height each below 3 mm
TGA_specimen_preparation: The prepared P/EM laminate was tested by simultaneous TG/DSC in air from 25 to 1000 °C at 10 °C/min. Specimen length, width and height were each below 3 mm. Mass, cutting or grinding procedure, through-thickness selection, pan, air flow and separate conditioning are unreported.
LOI_method: GB/T 8924–2005; CSI-101D oxygen index instrument, Shanghai Chengsi Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.; gas flow 5 L/min
LOI_statistic: Source tabulated scalar; averaging and replication unreported
LOI_specimen_preparation: Finished P/EM laminate specimens were waterjet cut according to the source-stated GB/T 8924–2005 oxygen-index method. LOI specimen dimensions and separate conditioning are unreported.
source_numeric_evidence_description: Original Table 1 TG data and Table 3 measured LOI, with own methods and the corresponding tables/figures visually checked in the official PDF. No numerical graph-coordinate extraction.
TG_locator: Section 1.6.2 on printed page 5545; section 2.2 and Figure 5 on page 5546; Table 1 and thermal prose on page 5547; PDF pages 6–8
LOI_locator: Sections 1.5 and 1.6.4 on printed pages 5544–5545; section 2.4 and Table 3 on page 5548, continuing page 5549; PDF pages 5–6 and 9–10
conditions_locator: Sections 1.1–1.6 on printed pages 5544–5545, Figures 2–3; PDF pages 5–6
source_location: Official PDF pages 3–16, printed pages 5542–5555; preparation PDF pages 5–6; Figure 5 PDF page 7; Table 1 PDF page 8; Table 3 PDF page 9
washing_state: Initial cured laminate after fabric treatment, repeated deionized-water rinsing to neutral and drying; no durability wash or ageing state assigned
treatment_method: Industrial aramid fabric from Tayho Advanced Materials was sequentially pretreated with toluene, acetone and deionized water in an HL-20 annular centrifugal extractor for a reported 3 h; whether this duration applies per liquid is not specified. The fabric was dried in a vacuum oven at 110 °C for 6 h. Fabric was then immersed in deionized water or the specified phosphoric acid solution at 40 °C for 24 h, repeatedly rinsed with deionized water to neutral and oven-dried at 80 °C for an unreported duration. E-51 epoxy and Z-6018 phenyl propyl polysiloxane were mixed at a 6:4 mass ratio using an unspecified amount of acetone, with a phosphazene catalyst of unspecified identity and loading, reacted at 15 °C for 5 h and rotary-evaporated for 2 h. The modified epoxy, 4-MHHPA and DMP-30 were mixed at 100:85.68:0.5 by mass and degassed at 70 °C and −0.08 MPa for 1 h. Twelve fabric layers were laid up by hand and cured in a JZ-5009 flat vulcanizing press at 5 MPa, 100 °C for 2 h and 150 °C for 5 h. Final fabric/resin mass or volume fractions, fabric areal density and weave are not reported.
source_T5_definition: Table 1 footnote: temperature at 5% mass loss.
source_Tmax_definition: Table 1 footnote: temperature at the first and second maximum mass loss rate; Figure 5(b) is DTG in %/°C.
source_residue_definition: Table 1 residual mass/char residue at 1000 °C from air TG, relative to the whole tested laminate. Table 2 mass residue belongs to cone calorimetry.
limitations: The same five concentration-labelled finished 12-ply fabric laminates occur in the preparation, air TG Table 1 and measured LOI Table 3. The 0% control was treated with deionized water under the stated 40 °C/24 h treatment, rinsed to neutral and dried; it is not an as-received fabric control. Phosphoric acid percentage basis, retained phosphorus or add-on, final laminate fabric/resin fractions, fabric areal density and weave are unreported. The source does not specify phosphazene catalyst identity/loading or the 80 °C drying duration. TG aliquot mass, pan, air flow, replicate count, conditioning and through-thickness selection are unreported; each TG specimen dimension is stated to be below 3 mm. LOI instrument and gas flow are explicit, but specimen dimensions, separate conditioning, replicate count and uncertainty are unreported. The mechanical specimens are described as 3 mm thick; that dimension is not assigned to LOI or TG. TG-IR is a separate assay with unreported atmosphere and its gas signals are not TG mass-loss metrics. Cone-calorimeter residues in Table 2 are excluded. All accepted numbers are printed Table 1/Table 3 values; Figure 5 is used only to check gross consistency. The official PDF and current issue list give pages 5542–5555, while an indexed article landing page gives 5547–5560; locators follow the retrieved PDF. Related earlier siloxane/epoxy articles describe precursor resins and fiber composites; exact equivalence of their aramid control observations is unresolved and requires comparison before any repeated control pair is imported.
sample_state: P/EM 0% phosphoric acid treatment; initial cured 12-ply aramid fabric laminate
composition: Twelve layers of aramid fabric treated with 0% phosphoric acid solution (0% denotes deionized water). E-51:Z-6018 mass ratio 6:4; modified epoxy:4-MHHPA:DMP-30 mass ratio 100:85.68:0.5. Final fabric/resin fraction unreported.
treatment_chemistry: Siloxane-modified epoxy with deionized-water-treated aramid fabric
source_concentration_basis: Percentage as stated; mass or volume basis unreported
pairing_evidence: Own preparation specifies the 0% treatment as a finished 12-ply aramid fabric/siloxane-modified epoxy laminate. Its identically concentration-labelled air TG row in Table 1 and measured oxygen-index row in Table 3 describe the initial cured specimen state. No precursor resin or fiber TG and no cone residue are substituted.
source_control_alias: Section 1.4 abbreviates the 0% formulation as P/E; tables use 0%.
